title: Shopify Launches AI Integration for Grok Bot to Run Online Stores

tickers.name: Shopify Inc. Class A subordinate voting shares
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Merchants can now connect their storefronts to Grok and Bot to automate the management of their online businesses. These new connectors allow users to link their accounts to monitor orders, track inventory levels and maintain product listings. Operators can also utilize the Grok interface to ask specific questions regarding their business data through the integration.

Elon Musk promoted the release, urging store owners to employ Grok Bot to oversee their operations. The integration is designed to let Shopify users build a team of AI agents to handle the daily functional requirements of running an e-commerce site.
